# Security & API Contract Checklist: Billing — InstaPay Claims

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the security, privacy and API-contract requirements of spec 020 (anti-enumeration, idempotency, rate limits, receipt storage and retention, audit, code handling, the C11 contract).
**Created**: 2026-10-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [`docs/openapi/paths/instapay.yaml`](../../../docs/openapi/paths/instapay.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard release gate. Audience: PR reviewer. Focus: anti-enumeration, idempotency, rate limits, receipts, codes, audit, the frozen contract.

## Anti-enumeration and uniform answers

- [x] CHK001 Is "identical answer" defined across status, body members, headers and work done, rather than status alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK002 Is the equal-timing requirement stated as a property of the design (no lookup on the submission path) rather than as an unmeasurable target? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008, Research §R-1]
- [x] CHK003 Are the per-address budget and its 429 specified to count registered and unregistered addresses alike, so the refusal itself discloses nothing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Do the redeem refusals avoid naming the claim address, the claim or another account, and is that stated as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK005 Is the operator-only `account_exists` fact kept off every `/api/v1` answer and every mail? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Idempotency

- [x] CHK006 Is the scope of a claim's key (anonymous) defined, with its collision consequence analysed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Research §R-2]
- [x] CHK007 Is it specified which outcomes are stored for replay (2xx only) and what happens to a refused request's key? [Completeness, Research §R-2]
- [x] CHK008 Is recovery defined for an `in_progress` record left behind by a crashed request, so the key does not answer 409 for 24 hours? [Gap, Exception Flow, Research §R-2]
- [x] CHK009 Is the canonical-body fingerprint defined precisely enough (key order, whitespace, base64 member) to be reproduced in a test? [Clarity, Research §R-2]

## Rate limits

- [x] CHK010 Are all three budgets quantified with window, count, key and status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK011 Is the order of validation, budget and idempotency replay specified for both operations? [Completeness, Research §R-3]
- [x] CHK012 Is the dependency of the per-origin budget on a correct client IP behind a proxy (trusted proxies) documented? [Assumption, Gap]

## Receipt images

- [x] CHK013 Are type, size, encoding and content checks for the screenshot all specified with their field codes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK014 Is protection at rest (encryption, key identifier, server-chosen path) specified for the stored image? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Research §R-5]
- [x] CHK015 Are the operator link's lifetime, guard, signature, caching and content-sniffing headers specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Research §R-10]
- [x] CHK016 Is every operator view of a receipt or an address required to be recorded, with its writer named? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014a, §FR-045]
- [x] CHK017 Is the retention clock's start ("closed") defined for every claim outcome, including an approved claim whose code is never redeemed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, §FR-022a]
- [x] CHK018 Are retention periods numbers, and are they required to appear in the baseline's retention table and the privacy commitments? [Measurability, Spec §FR-041]

## Redeem codes

- [x] CHK019 Are the code's alphabet, length, entropy, display form, input folding and storage form all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK020 Is the plaintext code's lifetime outside the mail bounded (encrypted queue payload; never logged; never stored)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037, §FR-040]
- [x] CHK021 Is a mail transport that writes messages to the application log excluded outside local development, given the mail carries the code? [Gap, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK022 Is the precedence among redeem refusals (unknown, same-account repeat, used, expired, mismatch, unverified) unambiguous and identical in spec and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, Contract]
- [x] CHK023 Are concurrent redemptions of one code required to produce at most one subscription, with the second answer defined? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032, Edge Cases]

## Audit and accountability

- [x] CHK024 Is each audited act mapped to exactly one event, one writer, an actor type and a subject type? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036, Research §R-9]
- [x] CHK025 Is the `claim_reviewed` detail shape fixed for all three outcomes, and consistent between spec and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036, Data model]
- [x] CHK026 Is it stated that free-text operator input (review note, revoke reason) never enters audit entries or mails? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, Data model]
- [x] CHK027 Are the review commands required to sit behind a fresh second factor when reached from a screen, and is the CLI exception justified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025, Plan A-27, A-28]

## API contract (C11 and landing page)

- [x] CHK028 Does every refusal the spec names appear in the path file with its status, and every new code carry a status, retry class and since-version plan? [Consistency, Spec §5, Contract]
- [x] CHK029 Is the redeem answer's `subscription.status` defined for a same-account repeat after the subscription changed? [Edge Case, Contract]
- [x] CHK030 Are the cross-origin (CORS) requirements for a browser-based landing page stated, or deliberately left at the framework default? [Gap, Dependency]
- [x] CHK031 Is the request size limit at the edge stated as a deployment requirement for 3 MiB receipts? [Dependency, Research §R-4]
- [x] CHK032 Is the platform restriction (`web` only) described as defence in depth rather than as a security boundary? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications]

## Data lifecycle across features

- [x] CHK033 Is what happens to a redeemer's identifier on claim and code records after account deletion (B15) defined? [Gap, Coverage]
- [x] CHK034 Is the claim record horizon (400 days) flagged against possible accounting retention needs? [Assumption, Spec §9]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Gaps found while generating this list were fixed in the spec, research and data model on 2026-10-05 (owner away): CHK008 (stale `in_progress` takeover after 60 s), CHK012 (trusted proxies as a deployment prerequisite), CHK021 (`log` mailer forbidden outside local), CHK025 (revoke detail `reason: null`), CHK030 (CORS left at the framework default, recorded), CHK033 (redeemer id kept as an identifier until the 400-day delete). The reviewer still owns every marker.
